title: Project Registry Row
description: One row in project_registry.csv. Auto-generated from ENA metadata, manually reviewed before Phase 3.

bioproject_accession.description: BioProject accession (PRJNA, PRJEB, PRJDB, ERP, SRP)

scope_basis.description: Why this project is in scope (e.g., 'current_project_paper_audit_2026-10-27')

primary_pmid.description: Primary PubMed ID for the main paper

paper_count.description: Number of papers associated with this project

run_n_local.description: Number of runs in local download

biosample_n_local.description: Number of biosamples in local download

has_intervention_metadata.description: Does the raw metadata contain intervention-group tags?

has_timepoint_metadata.description: Does the raw metadata contain timepoint information?

raw_group_values.description: Semicolon-separated unique group identifiers found in metadata

study_design_candidate.description: Auto-detected study design guess (before paper verification)

common_subject_id_fields.description: Detected attribute keys likely containing subject IDs

common_timepoint_fields.description: Detected attribute keys likely containing timepoint info

available_host_fields.description: Comma-separated list of available ENA structured host fields
